card.name: Small words in Ph+ leukemia dosing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or pieces such as with, in, or, + and ML inside kinase-inhibitor labels, right before or within Ph+ ALL/CML disease names, especially in pediatric patient groups.

modes.label: Linking word before Ph+ disease
modes.description: Words like with, in, or after patient groups, leading into Ph+ ALL or CML phase wording.
modes.example: Pediatric patients with:Newly diagnosed Ph+ CML<< in>> chronic phase at 230 mg

modes.label: Inside disease abbreviations
modes.description: The plus sign in Ph+ or the ML piece in CML abbreviations.
modes.example: Dose escalation is not recommended for pediatric patients with Ph<<+>> ALL, where Dasatinib tablets are

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and abbreviation pieces in leukemia drug labels that name Philadelphia-positive disease in children and adults.
